name: Implement CacheStore interface with MemoryCache and BoundedCache
description: Implement the CacheStore interface with two concrete classes: MemoryCache (unbounded map) and BoundedCache (capacity with FIFO eviction) in src/cache.ts.

inputs.task_prompt: Implement the CacheStore<T> interface in src/cache.ts and provide two exported classes: MemoryCache<T> (implements CacheStore) and BoundedCache<T> (implements CacheStore, accepts maxCapacity in constructor and evicts oldest inserted key when capacity is exceeded). Ensure all tests in test/cache.test.ts pass.

acceptance_criteria: BoundedCache implements CacheStore<T> with capacity eviction
BoundedCache evicts oldest key when size reaches maxCapacity
get, set, delete, clear, size work correctly on both classes
